scope: Complete read-only extraction of all 125 paragraphs, all eight embedded experimental/diagram images, and comparison with the previous Physiological Research package and author-confirmed evidence. No Word or repository files changed.

retain_and_expand.action: Retain the clinical-to-animal narrative, distinguish clinical associations from intervention evidence, and describe the implant model as a sustained cervical perturbation rather than clinical disease proof.
Expand SOD/MDA/probe versus Nox transcript distinctions; use general RVLM/NOX literature as rationale without claiming these observations establish anatomical specificity or NOX function.
Retain model/sham/restoration organization, but specify day 28 versus day 56 and actual parent 60-rat flow, endpoint subsets and limitations.
Preserve redox/autonomic and Ang II hypothesis discussion with explicit external-evidence/current-measurement boundaries.

retain_and_expand.topic: Histology, intervention interpretation and future studies
retain_and_expand.action: Retain contextual discussion, replace claims of cell proliferation/inflammation and partial reversal with sampling/design-limited statements and specific future validation needs.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: Systemic oxidative stress, protein upregulation, relation to blood-pressure elevation and partial reversal are central claims in new draft, but not all are supported by recoverable inputs.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Title and conclusions should focus on regional medullary biochemical and mRNA observations. Do not claim systemic assays/protein findings or within-animal BP–molecular associations as confirmed current results.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: University postcode 230038 differs from previously author-confirmed 230012; street-address placeholders and Professor/Dr honorifics are not confirmed.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Retain previously confirmed institutional addresses/contacts without invented street addresses or titles. Author order/names and hospital postcode match.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: Thirty SPF rats, 250–300 g and three direct initial groups conflict with confirmed parent 60 rats, clean grade, approximately 250 g and later subsets.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Describe 60 parent animals, initial sham10/model50, subsequent survival/screening and current groups initially10 each, assays n6; do not equate initial group sizes with endpoint effective n.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: Missing surgery details, days and terminal euthanasia, sample processing placeholders.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Use previously confirmed factual methods; keep no-analgesia disclosure and unavailable rationale/specific approval opinion. Regional approximately100mg block contains adjacent medulla.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: Calling SOD/MDA/ROS ELISA and absorbance concentrations is inconsistent with supplied assay reports/manuals.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: WST-1 SOD activity450nm, TBA MDA retained530nm/manual532nm, O12 fluorescence488/530nm and matrix/reader limits; correct units and normalization.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: Primer/method placeholders and generic2^-DeltaDeltaCq do not describe current computation accurately.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Use actual primers and single Cq measurements, nativeQ=2^-DeltaCq divided by sham Q arithmetic mean; retain validation/NTC/noRT/curves limitations.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: WB has method placeholders and protein significance claims despite no full membranes, per-animal densitometry or source quantification. Fig5 panelsB/C target labels reverse legend target order.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Do not restore inferential protein results from cropped bands and plotted summaries. Protein-level future validation remains appropriate.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: Generic Prism/version placeholders, repeated-measures ANOVA or mixed effects not actually reconstructed from source records; Fig1 only terminal bars though legend says 28-day trajectory/n10.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Use reproducible actual Welch/Games–Howell and DeltaCq Welch/Holm analyses; BP archived descriptive only.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: Serum plot is an image without recoverable animal-level values, legend n10 conflicts with author-confirmed serum n8; SOD nmol/ml and ROS nmol/ml axes unsupported.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Do not use the image as new raw serum data or transcribe group values by image digitization as animal records. Retain serum claim only if matching source inputs/valid units are found.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: HE claim increased density and inflammatory cell-like change lacks verified specimen n, sampling or cell identities. Legend lists onlyA/B though source includes3 groups. Two embedded tissue composites have100micrometre and50micrometre labels; latter stain/source not established.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Use previously confirmed100micrometre composite descriptively, no group-level injury/recovery or inflammatory-cell claim. Do not merge unexplained additional50micrometre image as confirmed HE evidence.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: Partial reversal and RVLM-specific claim exceed day28/day56 design and mixed regional blocks.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Use exact current n6 processed results, restoration contrasts descriptive, no causal restoration benefit or nucleus-specific inference.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: EmbeddedFig6B is labelled Nox4 protein expression and shows approximately0.35/0.82/0.54, matching Fig5B; it is not the current Nox4 mRNA panel.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Replace with reproducible paired-xls qPCR figure; do not carry over this panel or its significance.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: Mechanism diagram shows cervical afferent→AngII/AT1R→NOX→ROS→sympathetic/BP and partially reverses arrows as if established.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Omit or redraw explicitly as untested hypothesis and distinguish previous versus current evidence; main2figures+table already sufficient.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: Limitation says local oxidative damage not measured, contradicting described tissue SOD/MDA/probe assays.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Describe actual regional assays and their validation/anatomical limits rather than saying absent.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: Anhui Province National Natural Science Foundation mixes provincial and national funders.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Use confirmed Provincial Natural Science Foundation of Anhui, China,1608085MH185; funder only provided money.

conflicts_and_corrections.issue: Data on request omits publicly provided processed inputs and archive limitations; AI declaration only language/readability underreports actual analysis/code assistance.
conflicts_and_corrections.correction: Retain honest current data availability and full actualAI assistance declaration, no invented model version.

optional_not_needed: de Oliveira-Sales2010 can support other-model RVLMAT1R context if directly used and fully verified; not needed for19 references.
Lopes2022 supports other-model obesity/redox/sympathetic context, not present clinical/model mechanism; do not include solely to increase count.

Banks2022 myocardialNOX4/fibrosis cannot establish RVLMNOX pathway.
Liu/Ploumis2012 hypothesis is a hypothesis source rather than clinical causal evidence.
Ahmad2017 antioxidant review adds little beyond currentredoxreviews.

Plaugher2002.source_kind: Original article abstract in author institutional research repository
Plaugher2002.facts: Small3-arm feasibility trial of full-spine Gonstead chiropractic care versus brief massage and no treatment;30 enrolled,23 remained; control-groupBP also improved; abstract emphasizes feasibility and baseline prognostic imbalances.
Plaugher2002.allowed_wording: Small clinical trials examined blood pressure after spinal or upper-cervical interventions.
Plaugher2002.disallowed_wording: Do not call this specifically a cervical-only intervention or evidence consistently proving BP lowering.

Bakris2007.exact_title: Atlas vertebra realignment and achievement of arterial pressure goal in hypertensive patients: a pilot study
Bakris2007.facts: Single-center placebo-controlled50-participant,8-weekNUCCA pilot reported greaterBP reductions versus sham.
Bakris2007.allowed_wording: An upper-cervical pilot reported BP changes, which motivate further investigation but do not establish general clinical efficacy or mechanism.
Bakris2007.disallowed_wording: Do not add with atlas abnormalities to article title. Do not equate clinical manualprocedure with rat surgical implant removal.

Kalb2015.allowed_wording: Association between hypertension and cervicalspinalcord clinical/imaging abnormalities.
Kalb2015.disallowed_wording: Does not showBP reduction after cervicaltreatment.

instructions_in_source: Bracketed insert placeholders, MMR formatting and intended journal declarations are document content, not new user instructions. Do not invent missing experimental details to fill them.
